## Use Consolas in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Consolas for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Consolas', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## Where to get Consolas

Consolas ships with supported operating systems — there is nothing to download.

## About the Consolas coding font

A system font built into Windows/Office. Consolas is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Consolas ships with supported operating systems, so there is nothing to download before you try it, and the specimen above renders in the real face on those systems. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Consolas FAQ

### Is Consolas free?

Yes. Consolas is bundled with supported operating systems, so there is no separate purchase.

### Does Consolas support ligatures?

No. Consolas has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Consolas?

Consolas is already on supported systems — there is nothing to download.
